title: Mean Spatial Frequency Decoupling for Learning-Based Uplink-to-Downlink Covariance Conversion in FDD Massive MIMO
abstract: arXiv:2610.00596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In frequency division duplexing (FDD) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, the uplink (UL)-to-downlink (DL) channel covariance matrix (CCM) conversion problem is studied to relieve the heavy burden of DL training and feedback required for channel estimation. Learning- based methods perform well up to a certain array size, but for a fixed dataset size their accuracy deteriorates with the number of antennas, to the point where simple model-based methods outperform them. This paper identifies a key cause of this behavior and addresses it. The mean angle of arrival (AoA) induces a phase ramp along the lags of the CCM. Since the oscillation rate of this ramp grows with the number of antennas, a dataset of fixed size becomes increasingly sparse relative to the variation that must be captured. translated_title: FDD大规模MIMO中基于学习的上行到下行协方差转换的平均空间频率解耦
translated_abstract: 在频分双工（FDD）大规模多输入多输出（MIMO）系统中，本文研究了上行（UL）到下行（DL）信道协方差矩阵（CCM）转换问题，以减轻信道估计所需的下行训练和反馈的沉重负担。基于学习的方法在一定阵列规模内表现良好，但对于固定的数据集规模，其精度会随天线数量的增加而下降，以至于简单的基于模型的方法反而优于它们。本文识别了这一现象的关键原因并加以解决：平均到达角（AoA）会在CCM的滞后维度上引起一个相位斜坡，由于该斜坡的振荡速率随天线数量增长，固定大小的数据集相对于必须捕获的变化变得越来越稀疏。我们提出从UL CCM中单独估计该斜坡的斜率，并以闭式形式将其映射到DL频段，从而使后续学习部分……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现固定数据集下基于学习的FDD大规模MIMO上下行协方差转换方法精度随天线数增加而退化的关键原因是平均到达角引起的相位斜坡振荡加剧，并提出从上行CCM单独估计该斜坡斜率并以闭式形式映射到下行频段，通过解耦平均空间频率来提升大规模阵列下的转换精度。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that the phase ramp induced by the mean AoA, whose oscillation rate grows with antenna count, causes learning-based UL-to-DL covariance conversion in FDD massive MIMO to degrade with fixed dataset size, and proposes estimating the ramp slope separately from the UL CCM and mapping it to the DL band in closed form to decouple the mean spatial frequency and restore learning accuracy for large arrays.
